args.code: (() => { const dialogs = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog],dialog,.modal,[data-state=open],form')].map(d => ({role:d.getAttribute('role')||d.tagName, text:d.innerText.slice(0,400).replace(/\s+/g,' ')})); const headings = [...document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3')].map(h => h.innerText.trim()); const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].map(l => l.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,20); const inputs = [...document.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea')].map(el => ({tag:el.tagName,type:el.type||'',ph:el.placeholder||'',name:el.name||'',val:(el.value||'').slice(0,30)})).slice(0,25); const alerts = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=alert],.error,.text-red-500,.text-destructive')].map(e => e.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean); const main = (document.querySelector('main')?.innerText||'').slice(0,500).replace(/\s+/g,' '); return JSON.stringify({url:location.pathname, headings, labels, inputs, alerts, dialogCount:dialogs.length, dialogs:dialogs.slice(0,3), main}); })()
